    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_isolating_complex_of_module {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] {I : Type u_1} (X : I → FGModuleCat R) (i : I) (G : FGModuleCat R) (hHom : ∃ (z : G ⟶ X i), z ≠ 0) (hExt : ∀ (a : ℕ) (p : FreeHom.freeModule R a ⟶ G) [CategoryTheory.Epi p] (z : CategoryTheory.Limits.kernel p ⟶ X i), ∃ (s : FreeHom.freeModule R a ⟶ X i), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.Limits.kernel.ι p) s = z) (hOff : ∀ (j : I), i ≠ j → ∀ (z : G ⟶ X j), z = 0) :
    ∃ (a : ℕ) (b : ℕ) (c : ℕ) (f : FreeHom.freeModule R b ⟶ FreeHom.freeModule R a) (g : FreeHom.freeModule R c ⟶ FreeHom.freeModule R b), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g f = 0 ∧ (∃ (p : FreeHom.freeModule R a ⟶ X i), p ≠ 0 ∧ CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f p = 0) ∧ (∀ (q : FreeHom.freeModule R b ⟶ X i), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g q = 0 → ∃ (p : FreeHom.freeModule R a ⟶ X i), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f p = q) ∧ ∀ (j : I), i ≠ j → ∀ (p : FreeHom.freeModule R a ⟶ X j), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f p = 0 → p = 0
